title: buffer-mutex: reader and writer
summary: Two threads on a shared buffer: consistent only if they take turns.
hints: The writer fills the whole buffer with the pass number (`buffer[i] = pass` for every `i`); the reader checks that all elements equal `buffer[0]`. A reader that comes in the middle of a pass sees two different numbers.
With the `mutex` argument, take the SAME mutex around the whole fill and around the whole check, so passes are atomic as seen by the other thread.
